claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says mapped sunspots and coronal holes can serve as starship portals in a wormhole transit network between stars.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says black holes are theoretically entry-only portals but are not used because transit is dangerous and unpredictable.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says low-frequency solar events, often accompanied by sunspots, lower Earth's average frequency and make lower-astral interaction easier.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes these events from the sun's higher-frequency baseline.
